comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary over OC_comments with the same null and empty rules. They differ in eligibility. Feature 0 counts any external evidence from outside the OP's post, including sources/links and documented facts, and requires it to support a counter-argument. Feature 1 requires specific empirical evidence (concrete statistics, named studies, specific documented cases or observations) and explicitly excludes vague appeals. Feature 1 has no outside-the-OP requirement. A bare link or a general documented fact could count for 0 but not 1, and 1 could count an observation that 0 would not call external. These are different thresholds.
